title: The Sixteenth Recipe
author: Oscar Eriksen
blurb: Orsen Whitlock, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
